title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula eval case 4 names the refused date forms without spelling its own must_not_contain strings
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JDFo2s6eXsNxvQivW2pGpK)_
Fixes #26814

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` 第 4 例的参考答案改写——不再把自己 `must_not_contain` 要拒的两个字符串(JS 的 Date 构造、`today()` 加数字)原样拼出来,改为点名其形态;七个断言、全部事实一字不少,文件字节数不变(5407 B),token 棘轮行不动;附 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- 为什么改:参考答案自己含被拒字符串,按该例标准作答反而判错(总监复审 PR #26810 发现)。
- 风险与回滚:只改一条 JSON 字符串与一个 changeset,无 schema/行为变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`(第 4 例 `expected_output` 一行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到该文件 `1352 tokens (ceiling 1352; headroom 0)` 且总判定 ✓。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 受管面,Tier H,保持 draft 等 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准;席位不 ready/不入队)。

## What changes

- **Case 4 `expected_output`** of `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` no longer spells its own `must_not_contain` strings. The two phrases that carried them are reworded; everything else in the case is byte-identical:
  - "never `new Date()` / `Date.now()`" → "never a JS `Date` / `Date.now()`"
  - "never `today() + 45` (date arithmetic faults)" → "never date arithmetic on `today()` (it faults)"
- **Every assertion and fact kept**: the CEL-envelope seed `close_date: cel`daysFromNow(45)``, the determinism gate (two `os build` runs byte-identical), `daysBetween(today(), record.close_date)`, the `record.close_date - today()` duration-stored-as-`{}` trap, and the date-arithmetic fault. `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` are untouched.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/26814-formula-eval-case4-self-consistent.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch (the evals ship in the published catalog).
- No forced test edits. No ratchet row moves.

## Why

Case 4 refused `new Date(` and `today() + ` in an answer while its own reference answer contained both, so an answer that matched the reference was graded wrong. Found by the contract review of PR #26810 (card #26814).

## Tests

Per-case cross-check over the file (each case: no `must_not_contain` string inside its own `expected_output`, every `must_contain` string present), at `origin/main` 912076f8 and at this head:

```text
origin/main 912076f8:  case 4: must_not_contain "new Date(" PRESENT
                       case 4: must_not_contain "today() + " PRESENT
                       cases=7 failures=2
head f8531858:         cases=7 failures=0
```

`JSON.parse` of the file succeeds at this head.

| whole package, all `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines / bytes | 4605 / 224961 | 4605 / 224961 |
| whole package, all `skills/*/evals/*.json` lines / bytes | 1479 / 94793 | 1479 / 94793 |

Token = `ceil(bytes / 4)`, the convention `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` declares. Ceiling row for the file stays at 1352 (headroom 0, unchanged).

## Acceptance notes

- Same-byte rewrite achieved, so the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 was not needed and the ratchet row did not move.
- The cross-check script is a local probe (not committed); its two rules are the ones the card's acceptance line states.
